recipe.method: ridge filter and ranking, walk-forward selected (LEARNING-PLAN.md Part 4)

features.nulls: the training fold's mean (0 once standardised), no missing indicator
features.standardise: fitted on each training fold only; features with no spread in the fold dropped

labels.a: the watcher's own trade on the engine's lean, kinds idea and rejected only, the read's 1.5R-rule stop and first target (rejected rows from toPlan); gross = spread 0 and no commission, net = the read's spread and the pair's commission; keeps r, how, bars, mfe, mae
labels.b: a standard long and short at every check with features: stop = max(1.2 x ATR, the engine's noise-scaled minimum stop), target 1.5 x stop; same fills and window close; the result only (r, how), gross and net
labels.outcome: desk/outcome.mjs outcome(): buys fill at the ask, exits trigger on the bid (sells the reverse), closed at the window's end

models.penalty: mean squared error + lambda x ||w||^2 on the mean loss; intercept unpenalised; exact solve (Cholesky)
models.filter: trained on every check of kind idea or rejected with label (a), target a.gross.r, features signed by a.side
models.ranking: trained on every check with label (b), long and short rows pooled with mirrored features, one intercept, no side term
models.predictedNet: predicted gross R minus (spread + commission) / stop distance at the decision
models.threshold: the (1 - q) quantile of training-period predicted net R among training checks the unfiltered watcher alerted on; kept when at or above
models.p2Threshold: the ranking model's own: the (1 - share) quantile of the higher-side predicted net R over gate-open training checks (kinds none, idea, rejected) with label (b), share = (gate-open training checks alerted on / gate-open training checks) x q; traded when at or above

walkForward.train: London day before 1 January of the test year minus the purge, expanding
walkForward.score: mean net R of kept alerts over all test years, from the filtered watcher simulated through the alert sequence (reads.mjs alertPass with the predicate)
walkForward.nearTie: within one day-clustered SE (x sqrt(G/(G-1))) of the best: prefer the larger lambda, then the larger q
walkForward.finalFit: both models refitted on every development day before 2025-01-01 minus the purge, at the chosen lambda; both thresholds from those rows
walkForward.gaps: a check whose trade (label (a), or label (b) long or short, gross or net) would cross a hole of more than 4 bars on its way to its exit is gapAhead (dataset.mjs rowFor): not scored, so out of training, and left out of every alert pass (the predicate refuses it: it neither alerts nor starts a cooldown)

holdout.rule: looked at once. `final` checks everything that sees no outcome and records an armed entry to commit; `final --run` needs that entry committed, records started (model.json, $SCALP_DESK_HOME/learn/finals.log, ~/.scalp-desk/learn/finals.log and <git common dir>/scalp-desk-finals.log) immediately before the first outcome, then the results. A final that started or ran for an overlapping window, in any committed version of model.json, the working copy or any of the logs, refuses every later final and every refit. fit and final run only on <project>/desk/model.json and never in a shallow clone.

data.expected: every bar close in the window that src/sessions.js windowState calls open on a weekday, at the timeframe

holdout.reads: computed by the final itself (never dataset rows): reads.mjs at cost max, calendar full, rule 1.5R, with desk/features-extra.mjs
holdout.gaps: the walk-forward's rule: a held-back check that dataset.mjs rowFor marks gapAhead (a trade crossing a hole of more than 4 bars) is left out of the unfiltered and kept passes (so of the coin-flip baseline), of T2's pairs and of P2

tests.T1: filter: kept alerts' day-clustered lower bound of mean net R (x sqrt(G/(G-1))) above 0 at z, AND kept-minus-unfiltered mean net R per trade with a day-block-bootstrap lower bound (seed 20261016) above 0, AND at least 140 kept alerts; the filter applied before shouldAlert. Status becomes shadow only if T1 passes and the held-back window had not been looked at before (replay looks in model.json)
tests.T2: ranking: day-block-bootstrap lower bound (seed 20261017) of the correlation between side-aligned predicted net R and realised label-(b) net R, every holdout check with features, both sides, above 0; switches nothing on
tests.P2: exploratory only: the higher-predicted side where it is at or above P2's own threshold (models.p2Threshold), one position at a time, label (b), gate-open checks only
tests.baselines: the unfiltered watcher; a coin-flip side at each unfiltered alert = the average of the long and short outcomes with the alert's own distances, paired and day-clustered

bootstrap.unit: London day (UTC date of the alert)

costs.holdoutEvaluation: max: per check the larger of the fixed and the scaled spread, in the read and in the outcome

calendar.why: walk-forward and training rows use 'rules', the same for every development year (2017-2024, whose tier-1 tables are incomplete); the one held-back evaluation (T1, T2, P2 and the baselines on 2025-01-01T00:00Z..2026-10-14T20:45Z) uses 'full', the live desk's calendar. Features do not depend on the calendar; only which checks are tradeable does
